newsitem.title: INDIA: India 96/97 edible output seen at 6.7 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: India 96/97 edible output seen at 6.7 mln tonnes.

text.p: India's edible oil output in 1996/97 (November-October) is expected to rise to 6.7 million tonnes from 6.55 million tonnes in the previous year, the Central Organisation of Oil Industry and Trade (COOIT) said on Saturday.
Senior COOIT officials said edible oil imports in 1996/97 were expected to rise to between 1.4 million and 1.5 million tonnes from 1.14 million tonnes in the previous year.
"We expect edible oil imports in the current season to be between 1.4 and 1.5 million tonnes," O.P. Goenka, a senior COOIT official, told reporters at a conference on India's summer oilseeds crop.
India imported 1.09 million tonnes of edible oil between April and December 1996, COOIT said in a statement.
